title: Talbot effect for the periodic Benjamin--Ono equation
summary: We study the dependence on time of the spatial regularity of solutions to the periodic Benjamin--Ono equation with real, mean-zero initial data of bounded variation. For every datum with a nonzero jump, we prove that continuity and essential boundedness at an irrational time $t=2πα$ are equivalent to the arithmetic condition $\sum_j\log(q_{j+1})/\sqrt{q_j}<\infty$, where $q_j$ are the continued-fraction denominators of $α$.
